meta.title: Frankfurt, Verdi airport workers' strike
meta.timeUnit: minutes since timeOrigin, UTC (Frankfurt local time = UTC+1 in March before 30 Mar)
meta.source: OPDI flight list v2.0.0 (EUROCONTROL / OPDI, https://www.opdi.aero/), file flight_list_202503.parquet
meta.airportCoordinates: airportsdata Python package (MIT), derived from public airport databases
meta.coverageMethod: daily flights in the file that touch no German airport / median day (the strike itself reduced German traffic)
notes: Times are ADS-B first_seen / last_seen, not scheduled or wheels-off times.
other = -1 means the other airport is not determined in OPDI (often outside European ADS-B coverage).
Lines between airports are schematic (great-circle), not recorded trajectories.
Official cancellation figures are not in this file; they are reported separately in the interface.

events.label: Verdi strike at 13 German airports incl. Frankfurt (24 h, Monday 10 Mar)
events.official: 1,054 of 1,116 scheduled movements cancelled at FRA (dpa citing airport traffic control)

EPKK: John Paul II International Airport Kraków-Balice Airport
LIRP: Pisa / San Giusto - Galileo Galilei International Airport

diversions.method: Not applied: during the strike flights were cancelled, not diverted. The callsign test (regular EDDF arrivals seen landing elsewhere on 10 Mar) only found rescue helicopters and flights with an unknown destination, so no diversions are shown.
